semantics.ordered_keys: For FP16 bits u: negative values map to bitwise complement(u), others to u|0x8000. Only keys > 0x03ff (negative infinity) participate. Negative NaNs excluded, positive NaN payloads participate and order above positive infinity. Signed zeros remain distinct. This preserves source bit semantics rather than substituting a finite-value filter.
semantics.emission: Determine kth ordered-bit threshold; emit strictly greater keys in ascending input index order, then enough threshold ties in ascending input index order. Emit -1 for all remaining k_pad slots. k=0 fills the whole output with -1. k can exceed the number of participating values.
semantics.parallelism: 1024-thread radix histogram and ordered compaction. Aligned stride multiple8 allows 16-byte score loads; otherwise scalar fallback. R<=16,T>=32768,k_pad<=4096,k>0 uses G=min(32,max(2,T/(8*k))) split spans and merge when aligned.
semantics.workspace: No global mutable map or workspace. Planner reports potential split indices/scores/counts sizes; exact disjoint request-owned views must be supplied even when alignment selects fallback. Caller preallocates before execution. Empty workspaces must be canonical empty for nonsplit shapes. Preflight all views before writing.
semantics.shape_limits: Rows1..65535, static logical key count0..1048576, positive score stride >=key count, k_pad1..1048576, 0<=k<=k_pad, k>0 requires nonempty keys. Score F16[rows,stride], output I32[rows,k_pad]. No device-side dynamic T override in this API.
semantics.ownership: Private CUDA device kernels retain original MIT notice. Backend validates request identity, exact counts/types, alignment and pairwise overlap. Output and workspace belong to request/session. No allocation, host transfer or completion fence inside the operation. k=0 uses a device memset.

reference.oracle: Unmodified pinned device kernels with independent C ABI launch wrapper, default split and forced legacy each checked against independent NumPy threshold/index-order oracle; all FP16 payloads preserved.
reference.all_fp16_words: One 65536-element fixture enumerates all FP16 bit payloads through an odd affine permutation.
reference.layouts: Aligned and two-byte-shifted inputs; odd/even row strides; tail lengths, underfilled and empty-result rows, k0, k1, k512, k4096, k4097, k_pad beyond split threshold, R16/R17 split boundary, up to1048576 logical keys.
reference.history_scope: Checkpoint-derived scores originate from independent actual-matrix query captures and canonical compressed key rows, extended synthetically for long logical history. This is not a whole-model long-prefix generation proof.

verification.host_sanitizer_scope: Probe and inline host planning code instrumented with ASan/UBSan. CUDA host validation translation unit not instrumented by that build.
verification.gpu_sanitizers: CUDA memcheck with full leak check and initcheck on both replay modes; racecheck on160 synthetic calls. Zero reported errors/leaks/hazards.

performance.method: Median7 CUDA-event samples,400 top-k calls per sample through captured graphs; device kernels only versus pinned source, not vLLM or a full model.

limitations: Candidate source/use hierarchy and logical-entry remapping are not implemented by this component.
No full native attention, model admission, short/long/chunked/resumed generation qualification, serving throughput/tail-latency proof, or vLLM parity claim.
Static logical width only; source graph t_ptr/t_seq and tiled top-k APIs remain unexposed.
Current explicit component completion fences need coordinated asynchronous whole-model execution.
CUDA qualified on selected sm120a only. CPU and Metal paths unchanged.
